svg.title: In Türkiye, all four steps were higher in 2025 than in 2022
svg.desc: Dumbbell chart: In Türkiye, all four steps were higher in 2025 than in 2022: in 2022: Household internet: 94.2%, Internet use: 83.4%, Online shopping: 33.6%, Public authorities: 66.1%; in 2025: Household internet: 96.2%, Internet use: 89.8%, Online shopping: 42.3%, Public authorities: 71.3%.
